subject: general
question:
Given below are three statements followed by three conclusions I, II and III. Considering the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement****:**

All tanks are plates.

All cots are plates.

Some oats are cots.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some tanks are cots.

II. Some plates are tanks.

III. Some plates are oats.

options.text: Either conclusion I follows or II follows
Both conclusions II and III follow
